mentions.note: born 27.5.70; joined from Mitcham A.C. November 1984; pupil at Wilsons; won I.A.C. Cross Country 1982; youngest male AAA Championship gold medallist (road relays, Sutton Park, October 1983); 6th SCAAA Boys 1500 1984 4.20.63; 3000 9.19.3
